content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: XQL(ASM Key-Personnel External Footprint Exposure) AND (BIOC(Cortex ASM Discovery of Externally-Exposed Federated-Identity and App/CSP Surface) OR XQL(Help-Desk Account-Recovery Reconnaissance Burst) OR ABIOC(Anomalous Inbound Account-Recovery Cadence on Externally-Exposed Personnel)) AND XQL(TIM Attribution Muddled Libra Recon Tradecraft Match) observed on the same target_org within a 7-day window — fuses the ASM external-footprint exposure of key personnel, the repeated low-pressure help-desk account-recovery reconnaissance, and the TIM Muddled Libra attribution into ONE early-warning identity-takeover-precursor incident. The stitched recon storyline precedes and predicts the downstream MFA-reset identity takeover, so the reconnaissance phase itself becomes the terminal early-warning detection that fires before the takeover, not after.
rules.name: Scattered Spider Pre-Attack Recon Storyline — ASM Footprint x Help-Desk Profiling x TIM Attribution
